response.justification: While Bogdan has strong infrastructure and distributed systems experience, he fails to meet a critical minimum qualification: 8 years of C++ programming. His demonstrated C++ experience is approximately 1 year (National Instruments role plus thesis work), falling far short of the requirement. Additionally, his career progression has been in individual contributor roles (Senior/Staff Developer) rather than formal technical leadership positions, which the mid-senior Technical Lead role explicitly requires.
strengths: Extensive infrastructure and distributed systems expertise, demonstrated by managing microservices handling millions of requests per second at Dunnhumby
Strong commitment to software craftsmanship, testing practices (TDD), and establishing engineering standards, with evidence of mentoring through workshops and code kata sessions
Proven ability to architect and own complex, long-term technical projects, evidenced by founding and maintaining GISCollective since 2016
concerns: C++ programming experience (~1 year total) is critically below the stated minimum requirement of 8 years, representing a fundamental qualification gap
Career trajectory shows individual contributor and full-stack developer roles, not formal technical leadership or platform management positions as required
Limited evidence of leading cloud compute platforms or mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers, despite some AWS and Kubernetes exposure

key_factors.factor: C++ experience gap (8 years required vs ~1 year actual)
Lack of formal technical leadership experience
